title: We've decided to move
titleJp: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}すことにしました

canDos.text: Talk through a big decision with your partner (moving, changing jobs) and say what you've decided and why.
Read flat listings (rent, rooms, minutes from the station) and pick the one that fits both your conditions.
Give advice that builds on what someone has just told you ('If you're moving to Osaka, …').
Understand a friend or neighbour talking about things that happened to them (they were told off, their bike was taken).
Write a message telling friends about your decision and that you'll go ahead even if it's difficult.

task.goal: Choose your next home from three flats: share your information, weigh up the must-haves, and decide on one, even if it isn't perfect.

roles.a: Has the rent and floor plans of the three flats (card A)
roles.b: Has the travel times to work and notes on each neighbourhood (card B)

capstone.title: We're moving!
capstone.brief: Talk through whether to move (if it's near your work…, even if the rent is higher…), make the decision, then tell a friend (played by your partner) what you've decided and why, and answer their questions about the new place.
